sources.name: Whale Coin Talk Gambles
sources.selection_note: Selected for prospective testing because public timestamped low-cap calls include contract addresses. Historical wins are selection evidence only and are never imported into the experiment.

sources.name: Time Flies Degeneracy
sources.selection_note: Selected for prospective testing because public low-cap calls expose contract addresses and timestamps. No historical return is credited.

sources.name: SolCallAlert
sources.selection_note: Public near-real-time Solana smart/whale wallet activity feed. It nominates early candidates only; it never bypasses Wallet500 qualification and all forward misses remain in the ledger.

sources.name: SmugCalls
sources.selection_note: Open append-style timestamped call dataset with misses retained. Used as a transparent benchmark, not assumed alpha. Only rows newer than experiment start are ingested.
